gameDescriptionHtml:
In a world where civilization has long since disappeared, “The Last Farmer” invites you to engage in a struggle to revive a land drained of its vitality. Set in the forgotten reaches of Texas, where life once thrived, your mission is to survive and attempt to bring even a shadow of the world’s former glory back.

The world around you is full of dangers, and the main threat is the zombies. There are many of them, ranging from slow and clumsy to fast and deadly. These creatures are a constant menace, one you can’t easily escape. But even they can be of use: zombies can be processed into fertilizer, helping you restore the fertility of the dead land.

Your primary tool for survival in this desolate world is the farm you build and develop. Growing crops becomes the foundation of your existence, with water drawn from a lake to irrigate the land. Every seed planted is a step toward restoring this forsaken soil. Livestock also play a crucial role, providing meat for sustenance and manure for improving the soil.

But farming is only part of survival. You’ll need to craft tools and firearms to defend yourself and maintain your farm. Resources can be processed into biofuel, which is vital for keeping your operation running and surviving in this harsh world.

One of the key mechanics is assembling a vehicle. By scavenging parts scattered across the map, you can piece together a car that will become your reliable companion in this chaos. The vehicle will help you explore the land, and its trunk can be used to store looted resources. Additionally, it becomes a weapon against the zombies—run them down! At night, you can turn on the headlights to light your way, and if you need a break, you can listen to the radio.

Along the way, you’ll encounter corrupt military forces, whose motives are always questionable. Sometimes they may help, but more often, they’ll bring new challenges. Traces of other survivors still surface, but the question remains: are they real, or merely remnants of old legends?

“The Last Farmer” is more than just a survival story. It’s a journey through an empty world, where every step could be your last. Can you restore life to a place where it might no longer be possible? Or will the wasteland swallow you, as it has done to everyone else?
